prompt:
## Goal
Generate 30 NEW web site/app (desktop-first or responsive, used with mouse + keyboard) product/site topics for the scene below.

## Scene
开发者 / 技术团队 × ② 内容型
(L2 key: 开发者 · 内容型)

## Existing topics already in this scene (30) — your new topics MUST differ from EVERY one
1. 技术博客
2. RFC/设计文档
3. Changelog
4. 技术周刊
5. engineering team handbook and onboarding knowledge portal
6. architecture decision records browser for software teams
7. production incident post-mortem archive and reading site
8. step-by-step developer tutorial and walkthrough article hub
9. API reference documentation reading portal for developers
10. tech conference talk notes and speaker summary archive
11. programming language specification annotated browser and reader
12. security advisory and CVE digest site for developers
13. engineering scaling case study publication for startups
14. developer podcast episode transcript and show notes library
15. software system design pattern encyclopedia for engineers
16. open-source maintainer interview and contributor story magazine
17. developer tool review and comparison content site
18. software engineering glossary and terminology reference site
19. engineering performance benchmarks and industry metrics publication
20. developer ecosystem annual survey results and analysis portal
21. curated technical book summaries and reading list site
22. code review culture and best practices guideline site
23. open-source release notes aggregator for popular dev tools
24. software dependency and library update news digest
25. developer relations content hub and advocacy article blog
26. software engineering career interview experience article archive
27. open RFC proposal tracker with threaded community discussion
28. devops runbook and operational guide knowledge library
29. technical writing style guide for engineering documentation teams
30. engineering blog aggregator curated for software developers

## Hard requirements
1. Output a JSON array of EXACTLY 30 new topic strings, in English.
2. Each topic = a concrete, buildable product/site idea, 4-12 words. Not a generic feature name.
3. CRITICAL — in-scene differentiation: every new topic must be a genuinely different
   sub-niche or use-case from EVERY existing topic listed above. Do NOT produce
   paraphrases, synonyms, renamings, or minor variations. Example: if "freelance
   invoice tracker" already exists, do NOT emit "invoice management tool for
   freelancers". If an idea overlaps in concept with any existing topic, discard it
   and find a different angle (different audience, sub-domain, mechanic, or context).
4. The 30 new topics must also be clearly distinct from each other.
5. Stay strictly within the scene — every topic must clearly belong to: 开发者 / 技术团队 × ② 内容型
6. Lean web-native: e.g. "open-source contributor leaderboard site", not a phone-only idea.
7. Output pure JSON — a single array of strings. No markdown fences, no commentary.

Return ONLY the JSON array of 30 strings.
